integrity: The proof is analytical. The bundled standard-library checker executes 12,112 deterministic diagnostics and is not an exhaustive verification of the continuum theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exact analytical result for a scalar piecewise-linear active-unit model with positive constant repair/damage rates, fixed positive duty and a stipulated constant cost per cycle. Not a calibrated biological or engineering optimization. Historical priority remains provisional, particularly because the Papadakis et al. 2012 complete article was inaccessible.
title: A duty-invariant switching-cost threshold for periodic photosynthetic repair
